## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

If the fixed-triple variety is empty, every normalized real moment functional with equal degree-two and degree-one ranks and finite relation compatibility has a degree-two moment matrix that is not positive semidefinite.

### Governing Obligation
Emptiness is a hypothesis and is not established for any MU triple.
